name: codex-profiles
title: Codex Profiles
description: Open named Codex profiles and their bound projects in ChatGPT or Terminal, and check each profile's remaining Codex quota.
author: ducksss

commands.name: open-profile
commands.title: Open Profile
commands.subtitle: Codex Profiles
commands.description: Open a profile's ChatGPT window or its Codex CLI in Terminal.

commands.name: open-workspace
commands.title: Open Workspace
commands.subtitle: Codex Profiles
commands.description: Open a project folder with the profile it is bound to, in ChatGPT or Terminal.

commands.name: codex-usage
commands.title: Codex Usage
commands.subtitle: Codex Profiles
commands.description: See how much Codex CLI quota each profile has left and when each limit resets.

preferences.name: codexProfilePath
preferences.title: codex-profile Path
preferences.description: Full path to the codex-profile command. Leave empty to look in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and your login shell's PATH.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
